canonicalisation_boundary: Canonical numerators identify structurally equal expressions and sign reversals and omit exact zero entries. They are not claimed to be a minimal generating set or a Groebner basis.

forward_implication.premise: Every literal-system solution satisfies every equation in the 2,552-equation shared core.
forward_implication.rule: If the shared core forces [Q_i,Q_j]=0 for 1<=i<j<=4, then the literal system does as well.
